title: The Enthusiastic crowd at the match
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：enthusiastic　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 enthusiastic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the clerk wrote of ① an enthusiastic crowd at the match in the file, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② more enthusiastic than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the clerk, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the enthusiastic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most enthusiastic crowd at the match anybody in the office had ever seen, or so the file for May 1954 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too enthusiastic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the applicant who had come to help; the enthusiastic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an enthusiastic welcome at the door, and said that no applicant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as enthusiastic as the welcome at the door they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was enthusiastic or not, and he said so.

By 1967 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the file. What the line asked for was ⑦ something enthusiastic, and nothing besides. The applicant from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite enthusiastic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the file kept the names of the enthusiastic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1970, in public, she wrote of another enthusiastic crowd at the match in the same file, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more enthusiastic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most enthusiastic welcome at the door in the whole office, she said in 1972, was the one she could never quite name; the enthusiastic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 热情（前置定语 an enthusiastic crowd at the match：1960 年书记员在卷宗里记下的那件热情的观众）
B. adj. 热情／热烈（比较级 more enthusiastic than：文中两处，一处比赛场上的观众，一处比预想）
C. adj. 热情／热烈（最高级 the most enthusiastic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 热情（表语 too enthusiastic to do：母亲觉得它太热情，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 热烈（前置定语 an enthusiastic welcome at the door：叔叔把整件事称作一桩热烈的欢迎）
F. adj. 热烈（同级比较 as enthusiastic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩门口的热烈欢迎相比）
G. adj. 热烈（后置定语 something enthusiastic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 热烈（受程度副词修饰 quite enthusiastic：那位申请人的评价）

items.q: an enthusiastic crowd at the match
the most enthusiastic crowd at the match anybody
an enthusiastic welcome at the door
The most enthusiastic welcome at the door in

answers.why: enthusiastic 意为“热情”，1960 年书记员在卷宗里记下的是“一件热情的观众”，此处作前置定语 an enthusiastic crowd at the match。
enthusiastic 意为“热情”，此处用比较级 more enthusiastic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
enthusiastic 意为“热情”，卷宗上 五月 那行字说它是办事处里最热情的一件，故用最高级 the most enthusiastic crowd at the match。
enthusiastic 意为“热情”，母亲认为这件东西“太热情了，谁也用不上”，too enthusiastic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
enthusiastic 意为“热烈”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩热烈的欢迎”，此处作前置定语 an enthusiastic welcome at the door。
enthusiastic 意为“热烈”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩门口的热烈欢迎一样热烈”，同级比较用 as enthusiastic as。
enthusiastic 意为“热烈”，卷宗上那半行字要的是“热烈的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something enthusiastic。
enthusiastic 意为“热烈”，邻办事处来的那位申请人认为这套计划“相当热烈”，quite 修饰原级 enthusiastic。
enthusiastic 意为“热烈”，1970 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要热烈”，故用比较级 more enthusiastic than。
enthusiastic 意为“热烈”，母亲 1972 年说的是“整个办事处里最热烈的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most enthusiastic welcome at the door。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1960 年，书记员在卷宗里记下了一件热情的观众。（an enthusiastic crowd at the match）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更热情。（more enthusiastic than …）
母亲觉得它太热情，谁也用不上。（too enthusiastic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩热烈的欢迎。（an enthusiastic welcome at the door）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩门口的热烈欢迎一样热烈。（as enthusiastic as …）
到了 1967 年，卷宗上只剩半行字：要的是一件热烈的东西。（something enthusiastic）
answers: In 1960 the clerk wrote of an enthusiastic crowd at the match in the file.
Everybody said it was more enthusiastic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too enthusiastic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an enthusiastic welcome at the door.
He said nobody would call it as enthusiastic as the welcome at the door they had once had.
By 1967 the file asked for nothing but something enthusiastic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 enthusiastic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1960 the clerk wrote of an enthusiastic crowd at the match in the file, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most enthusiastic crowd at the match in the office, or so the file says.
My mother thought it too enthusiastic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an enthusiastic welcome at the door, and nobody argued with him.
The applicant from the next office called the plan quite enthusiastic, and everybody laughed.
The enthusiastic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
